claim.summary: Schema-authoritative capability manifests register as detached immutable JSON, component prop types derive from their literal schema, and deterministic inspector plans retain unsupported properties through explicit structured-JSON fallbacks.

directTraceRules.summary: An Editor resolves catalog authoring contracts
A catalog declares one target package contract while executable code stays outside JSON
A Capability Package provides or explicitly delegates resource and operation bindings
Exclusive behavior channels conflict unless contracts explicitly declare compatibility
Behavior capabilities expose only the same declared public contract surfaces as components
Component manifests declare their complete public property, composition, interaction, style, authoring, and deprecation contract
Authoring metadata guides controls and scenarios but never weakens the property schema
Operations declare schemas, public errors and effect class, while current host authorization governs execution
Resources are read-oriented schema contracts and domain mutation uses operations
The host binds capability IDs to trusted code rather than document-selected service details
Property controls derive from schema and unsupported schema features remain editable through an honest fallback
Behavior mechanics remain capability implementations rather than new core primitives

publicApi.inspectorAuthority: propsSchema selects control kind, requiredness, enum options, and honest fallback
publicApi.authoringControlHints: detached opaque sidecars without schema authority
publicApi.hostOperationAndResourceBindings: deferred to M03-T08 and runtime layers

limitations: The SDK accepts programmatic object input; duplicate members already lost by an external JSON parser cannot be detected here.
A general JavaScript Proxy cannot be classified without allowing its traps to run; callers must not use proxies as authoring input.

Promise, generator, iterator, and host-exotic internal slots have no universal side-effect-free ECMAScript brand probe; if their prototypes are deliberately replaced with Object.prototype, their observable enumerable data shape is what gets snapshotted.

TypeScript may erase extra-property information when a structural union member absorbs another member; Catalog structural validation remains authoritative for nested manifest shape in that language-level edge case.
The atomic writer assumes its real parent directory is not concurrently controlled by an attacker during the final verified rename window.
TypeScript projections and inert snapshotting do not replace Catalog structural or semantic validation.
JsonSchemaValue is a conservative TypeScript projection; unsupported Draft 2020-12 features fall back to JsonValue rather than pretending to be exact.
DESEN 0.1.0 defines no authoring.controls vocabulary; PF-025 keeps hints opaque and non-authoritative.
The component inspector plan is framework-neutral metadata, not a concrete editor widget tree.
packageDigest is caller-supplied until M03-T04 defines the deterministic Web-React package profile.

Manifest registration intentionally does not carry executable behavior production, operation execute, or resource read functions; host bindings remain a later runtime responsibility recorded by PF-024.

Direct trace ownership confirms registration and derivation primitives only; concrete editor widgets, authorization, host execution, read-only resource behavior, adapter integration, and final parity remain assigned to later tasks.
No P-* claim changes status and G03 remains open.
